name: Nozaki Sumire
source: Daughter of the owner and ringmaster of a small travelling circus; she works there as an acrobat. Loves her father and the circus very much, but the constant travelling means she hardly can make friends, giving her father cause to concern; on top of that, the circus doesn't do well in terms of profit, being surpassed by modern leisure activities such as TV, so she can't go to school and has to help her father run the circus.
translation: Daughter of the owner and ringmaster of a small travelling circus; she works there as an acrobat.
